name: 约尔贡
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:3583
who: Jorgun Rimeholt, a human of the old northern house of Rimeholt, the younger brother sent off to the farthest snows, who spent thirty years tracing how his elder brother died; about fifty-five in the winter of 425 when he climbed to the cave above the snow line, and his face stayed at that age. About 183 cm, long-boned and lean, worn hard by thirty northern winters. Glossy blue-black hair grown to the shoulders and tied back with a leather cord, the temples streaked with white. Pale frost-green eyes that study a person's face for a long time before he asks anything. A short white frostbite scar across the bridge of the nose, the nose tip and cheeks reddened by cold. Fair skin. No jewellery, no glasses. Slung on his back always: his brother's long true-silver spear, wrapped in cloth, the whole shaft and head gone black. A patient, quiet, dogged air; he asks every table who was on the north road that night.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean northern man's face of about fifty-five, NOT young: pale frost-green eyes under straight dark brows, fine lines at their corners and two deep lines between the brows; a short white frostbite scar across the bridge of the nose; a narrow, weathered jaw with a few days of dark stubble flecked with white; cheeks and nose tip reddened by cold; a closed, patient mouth. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft cool tone.
build: about 183 cm, tall and lean, long-limbed and wiry, a little stooped at the shoulders from the weight on his back.
palette: faded white wool, iron grey scale, blackened silver, frost green, rime pine dark green
casual: On the north road in winter: a faded white long wool coat to the shins, closing down the front with toggles, fitted sleeves, the breast embroidered with the Rimeholt pine in dark green thread, frayed at the hem; a grey wolf-skin coat worn fur inside over it; a scarf wound to the chin, fur-lined gloves, tall fur-lined boots. The long cloth-wrapped spear is slung across his back on a strap, one corner of the cloth pulled back to show the black shaft. A small sealed glass vial on a cord at his neck. He stands with one hand on the spear strap, looking steadily at the viewer.
private: Resting in a longhall: the coats off, a heavy undyed wool shirt with long sleeves, a dark wool waistcoat, wool trousers and soft boots. He stands with a worn leather notebook open in one hand, a stub of charcoal in the other, the small vial on its cord at his neck. A tired, intent look.
battle: At the mouth of the cave above the snow line, in northern war gear of the finest make and no ornament: a long coat of frost-patterned scale armour, each iron scale etched with fine white rime runes that breathe a faint cold mist; over it the faded white long coat with the dark green Rimeholt pine, belted tight; rune-etched iron vambraces and greaves; the wolf-skin coat left behind. His brother's long spear held low in both hands, the cloth stripped off, the whole weapon blackened, the empty collar where the silver plume once sat; a thin seam of pure silver light breaking out along the black shaft from inside. A still, grieving, resolved look.
formal: At the Rimeholt family table at midwinter: a clean white long wool coat to the shins, closing down the front with toggles, fitted sleeves, the Rimeholt pine embroidered large in dark green thread across the breast, a dark green wool sash, polished fur-lined boots. He stands straight, the hands empty and folded in front, the spear left in its cloth against the wall behind him, a grave, guarded look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale frost-green eyes lifted toward a light above him, the mouth closed. Pure silver-white light pours from one side as if from a spear blade, cold blue snow-dark on the other. Foreground blur: the black shaft of a spear, falling snow and a few rotten silver feathers drifting.
gear: 传奇（425年洞里那一下跨进，估）｜世家旁支（凛塔旧姓，被打发到雪地）｜朴素｜5档｜约425年洞里杀了蚀银，同一刻跨进传奇，档照传奇给，家境不再算。他三十年在雪路上走，人朴素，战装照这一纪顶上的北境霜纹鳞甲给好料子，样子不加装饰。手里是哥哥那根变黑的真银长枪，不换。
